comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
"Court Gardener"
Comes from a 5-star quest available from London's Adventure Mediator, requires Caribbean port permits, R5 Ecological Research, R3 Procurement, and Spanish language (body language will probably be enough). Quest steps:

1 London - Talk to Port Official
2 London - Talk to Scholar
3 Santo Domingo - Talk to Market Keeper
4 Santo Domingo - Talk to Tavern Master
5 London - Talk to Scholar
6 London - Talk to Port Official

comments.author: Donce
comments.body: The quest for job is available already. It is chrono quest (17th century 3rd period) but shareable.

comments.author: V_I
comments.body: It's also the cheapest job to change into without a card that favors Trap skill! For adventurers like me who love to summon hordes of stinging wasps without having to go after a new Ruin Explorer job card, that's great news.

comments.author: Almeida
comments.body: It may be mere coincidence, but this job quest didn't show up for me until I had completed a 17th century quest and changed my title accordingly.

comments.author: V_I
comments.body: I think it's coincidence, I got this job's quest without using any Chrono Quest titles. I did use Adventurer Graduate to get it the first time, but I've since seen it while using other titles, too.

comments.author: Veri
comments.body: I always use Adventurer Graduate title when I'm looking for specific adventure quest. You don't need chrono title for this quest.
